## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
DD1, DD2, DD3, DD4, DD5 (pre-implementation RED tests)

## TDD (6 scenarios)
Given/When/Then for each:
1. RateLimitError injected on primary → fallback provider answers; hop rendered in summary
2. ContextWindowExceededError on haiku → sonnet tier answers (same provider)
3. Full chain failure → fallback_exhausted JSON entry (6 fields: agent_id, primary_model, attempted_cross_provider[], attempted_context_models[], final_exception_class, final_exception_message)
4. Contract conformance: fallback_exhausted JSON validates against expected schema
5. streaming=False preserved across all hops (assert every litellm.completion call has streaming=False)
6. startup credential check → raises ConfigError when provider credential missing

File: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch.py
.test-index: RED marker [test_rate_limit_error_triggers_fallback] for dso_ci_review/dispatch.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (RED marker exempts failing dispatch tests)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] test_dispatch.py exists with at least 6 test functions
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch.py && grep -c "def test_" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch.py | awk '{exit ($1<6)}'
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for dispatch.py
  Verify: grep '\[test_rate_limit_error_triggers_fallback\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
